t: The Philosophy of Controlled Explosions and the Inevitable AI Retcon
s: Modern AI development is fundamentally iterative and controlled, akin to 'gunpowder' explosions, contrasting with dangerous, integrated 'nitroglycerin' systems. This controlled approach, exemplified by ephemeral LLMs and gradual model updates, ensures safety and allows humanity to adapt to rapidly evolving AI capabilities.
sub: AI safety through iterative development and ephemeral models ('Mr. Meeseeks' protocol).
The 'gunpowder' (Unix-like, modular) vs. 'nitroglycerin' (LISP-like, integrated) dichotomy in AI and computing.
Technological 'retcon' where the magical becomes mundane, driven by AI's accelerating content generation and lowered publishing friction.
AI as a 'matter-hack,' challenging anthropocentric views of intelligence and emphasizing the potential of organized matter.
